messages:
emma: Quick UI review from security design: the Project > Encryption row currently says `KMS` only. Feels too terse for non-security folks. Also retention dropdown disables shorter options in some regions with no explanation. Screenshot: https://rwd.slack/FIG1 :eyes:

liam: Agreed. Suggest full label `Customer-managed keys (KMS)` and a small info button with accessible tooltip. Keep label short but expand in tooltip.

sofia: Tooltip copy suggestion: `Use your cloud provider's Key Management Service (KMS) to control encryption keys for stored artifacts.` Keep it single sentence and avoid punctuation that confuses screen readers.

aria: Accessibility notes: tooltip must be keyboard focusable (tabindex=0) and use aria-describedby for relation. Icon contrast fails with current brand color on white background; aim for 4.5:1. Don't rely on color alone to indicate compliance badge.

emma: For retention helper, propose this below the select: `Retention options vary by region and legal constraints. See Security docs for details.` Link text should be descriptive — not "click here".

liam: Implementation detail: don't put links inside <option> elements. Instead render helper text outside the select and update aria-live region when the select receives focus so screen readers get context.

sofia: Audit log copy needs clarity. Current entry `Encryption key changed` is ambiguous. Recommend `Encryption key rotation initiated` for rotation start and `Encryption key rotation completed` for completion. Include redacted key identifier.

oliver: Backend event we emit is `kms_key_rotate`. We'll add fields: `action: initiated|completed`, `key_alias`, `redacted_arn`. UI should surface `key_alias` and show truncated ARN like `arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd... (redacted)` with a copy button.

aria: Make the copy button `aria-label=\"Copy full key ARN\"`. When copy succeeds announce "Key ARN copied" via aria-live polite. Also ensure tooltip with full ARN is accessible to keyboard users and screen readers.

liam: Small UX touch: in Compliance mode sort regions by compliance support and show a tiny `Compliance-ready` badge next to region names. Mark badge as aria-hidden if purely decorative and include an accessible phrase in the region label like "EU (compliance-ready)" for screen readers.

emma: I'll update the mock: label -> `Customer-managed keys (KMS)`, add helper line under retention select, change audit log wording to initiated/completed, and add truncated ARN + copy affordance. Ping @oliver to add API contract fields.

oliver: I'll open a PR with API docs and tweak the audit event text. Will include unit tests for redaction.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued for branch feature/kms-ui-nits by oliver. ETA ~15m. :rocket:

aria: Once PR is up, I'll run an a11y pass focusing on keyboard navigation, aria attributes, and color contrast.

emma: Great — thanks all. Leaving this as a short design nit thread. I'll attach updated figma screens: https://rwd.figma/kms-retention-v3 :sparkles:
